examples: The sailors had to abandon the sinking ship before it went under.
ملوانان مجبور شدند قبل از غرق شدن کشتی آن را ترک کنند.
After the funding fell through, the city decided to abandon the park renovation project.
پس از قطع بودجه، شهرداری تصمیم گرفت پروژه بازسازی پارک را رها کند.
She refused to abandon her dream of becoming a doctor, even after failing the exam twice.
او حتی بعد از دو بار رد شدن در امتحان، حاضر نشد رویای پزشک شدنش را رها کند.
miniContext: When people abandon something, they leave it behind completely, often because continuing has become impossible or pointless. Sailors abandon a sinking ship, families sometimes abandon homes after a disaster, and writers occasionally abandon a project halfway through. The word carries a sense of finality — once you abandon something, you are not planning to come back to it.

examples: She has always been keen on learning new languages.
او همیشه به یادگیری زبان‌های جدید مشتاق بوده است.
His keen sense of smell helped him find the gas leak before anyone else noticed.
حس بویایی تیز او باعث شد نشتی گاز را قبل از هر کس دیگری پیدا کند.
The coach praised the rookie's keen eye for spotting weaknesses in the opposing team.
مربی چشم تیزبین تازه‌کار را برای شناسایی ضعف‌های تیم حریف ستایش کرد.
miniContext: Someone who is keen feels strong enthusiasm or interest, and the word can also describe a sense or mind that is especially sharp. A student keen on history will read far beyond the assigned chapters, while a keen sense of hearing lets a musician catch the smallest mistake in a performance. Both uses share the idea of sharpness, whether in feeling or in perception.

examples: He felt jealous when his younger brother got all the attention at the party.
وقتی برادر کوچکترش در مهمانی تمام توجه‌ها را به خود جذب کرد، او حسادت کرد.
She grew jealous of her coworker's quick promotion, even though she tried not to show it.
او به ترفیع سریع همکارش حسادت کرد، با اینکه سعی می‌کرد آن را نشان ندهد.
Jealous of his friend's new car, Tom started saving money for one of his own.
تام که به ماشین جدید دوستش حسادت می‌کرد، شروع کرد برای خریدن یکی مثل آن پول‌اندازی کند.
miniContext: Being jealous means feeling resentful or insecure because someone else has something you want, whether that is attention, success, or a relationship. A jealous sibling might sulk when a parent praises the other child, and a jealous partner might worry needlessly about every text message. The feeling usually comes from comparing yourself to someone else and feeling you are falling short.

examples: The nurse delivered the bad news with great tact, choosing her words carefully.
پرستار خبر بد را با نزاکت زیادی و با انتخاب دقیق کلمات بیان کرد.
Handling a client's complaint requires tact as well as patience.
رسیدگی به شکایت یک مشتری هم به نزاکت نیاز دارد و هم به صبر.
He lacked the tact to tell his boss the idea was weak without sounding rude.
او نزاکت کافی نداشت که به رئیسش بگوید ایده‌اش ضعیف است بدون اینکه بی‌ادب به نظر برسد.
miniContext: Tact is the skill of saying difficult or sensitive things in a way that does not upset or offend the listener. A doctor needs tact when explaining a serious diagnosis, and a manager needs tact when criticizing an employee's work. People who have tact know how to be honest without being hurtful, choosing the right moment and the right words.

examples: The new president took the oath of office in front of thousands of spectators.
رئیس‌جمهور جدید سوگند ریاست‌جمهوری را در برابر هزاران تماشاگر یاد کرد.
Witnesses in court must swear an oath to tell the truth.
شاهدان در دادگاه باید سوگند بخورند که حقیقت را بگویند.
He broke his oath of loyalty when he leaked the company's secrets to a rival.
او با فاش کردن اسرار شرکت به رقیب، سوگند وفاداری‌اش را شکست.
miniContext: An oath is a solemn promise, often made formally and sometimes in a legal or ceremonial setting. Soldiers take an oath when they join the army, witnesses take an oath before testifying, and newly elected officials take an oath before starting their duties. Breaking an oath is considered especially serious because it was a sworn commitment, not just an ordinary promise.

examples: The apartment next door has been vacant for almost six months.
آپارتمان کناری تقریباً شش ماه است که خالی مانده است.
We found a vacant seat near the back of the theater just before the show started.
درست قبل از شروع نمایش، یک صندلی خالی نزدیک انتهای سالن تئاتر پیدا کردیم.
After losing her job, she stared at the wall with a vacant expression, unsure what to do next.
او بعد از از دست دادن شغلش با نگاهی خالی و بی‌روح به دیوار نگاه می‌کرد، بدون اینکه بداند بعد چه کند.
miniContext: Something that is vacant is empty or unoccupied, whether it is a building with no tenant, a chair with no one sitting in it, or a job with no one hired for it yet. The word can also describe a facial expression that shows no thought or emotion, as if the mind behind it were temporarily empty. A vacant lot in a city, for instance, is land with no building and no current use.

examples: The family endured great hardship during the long winter without heating.
آن خانواده در طول زمستان طولانی بدون گرمایش، سختی زیادی را تحمل کرد.
Many immigrants face financial hardship in their first years in a new country.
بسیاری از مهاجران در سال‌های اول زندگی در کشور جدید با سختی مالی روبرو می‌شوند.
Despite the hardship of losing his job, he managed to keep his family afloat.
او با وجود سختی از دست دادن شغلش، توانست خانواده‌اش را سر پا نگه دارد.
miniContext: Hardship refers to difficult living conditions or serious suffering, often caused by poverty, war, illness, or loss. A story about hardship might describe a family struggling to pay rent, or a community rebuilding after a natural disaster. The word emphasizes ongoing difficulty rather than a single bad moment, suggesting a period of real struggle that someone has to endure.

examples: The knight made a gallant effort to rescue the villagers trapped in the burning building.
شوالیه تلاش شجاعانه و جوانمردانه‌ای برای نجات روستاییان گیر افتاده در ساختمان درحال‌سوختن انجام داد.
In the old novel, the gallant hero always defends the weak against injustice.
در آن رمان قدیمی، قهرمان شجاع و جوانمرد همیشه از ضعیفان در برابر بی‌عدالتی دفاع می‌کند.
He gave up his seat in a gallant gesture, letting the elderly woman sit instead.
او با حرکتی جوانمردانه صندلی‌اش را واگذار کرد تا زن مسن بنشیند.
miniContext: Gallant describes brave, honorable behavior, especially when someone takes a risk to help or protect others, often in a way that seems old-fashioned or chivalrous. Soldiers who charge into danger to save a wounded comrade are called gallant, and so is a stranger who steps in to defend someone being treated unfairly. The word combines courage with a sense of nobility and selflessness.

examples: The scientists collected data from hundreds of weather stations across the country.
دانشمندان داده‌هایی را از صدها ایستگاه هواشناسی در سراسر کشور جمع‌آوری کردند.
Before making a decision, the company analyzed sales data from the past three years.
شرکت قبل از تصمیم‌گیری، داده‌های فروش سه سال گذشته را تحلیل کرد.
Without reliable data, the researchers could not draw any firm conclusions about the disease.
بدون داده‌های قابل اعتماد، محققان نتوانستند هیچ نتیجه‌گیری قطعی درباره بیماری بگیرند.
miniContext: Data refers to facts, figures, or information gathered for analysis, usually to answer a question or support a decision. Scientists gather data through experiments, businesses gather data through sales records, and governments gather data through surveys and censuses. Good decisions usually depend on having accurate and complete data rather than guesswork.

examples: She was unaccustomed to the bitter cold after years of living in a tropical climate.
او بعد از سال‌ها زندگی در آب‌وهوای گرمسیری، به سرمای شدید عادت نداشت.
Unaccustomed to public speaking, he stumbled over his words during the presentation.
او که به سخنرانی در جمع عادت نداشت، در طول ارائه کلمات را به‌هم ریخت.
The dog seemed unaccustomed to city noise and barked at every passing car.
سگ به نظر می‌رسید به سروصدای شهر عادت نداشته باشد و به هر ماشین عبوری پارس می‌کرد.
miniContext: Someone who is unaccustomed to something is not used to it, usually because they have little or no experience with it. A person unaccustomed to spicy food might struggle with a dish that locals eat easily, and someone unaccustomed to early mornings might find a 5 a.m. shift exhausting. The word highlights the gap between what feels normal to someone and a new situation they have not adapted to yet.

examples: At forty, he was still a bachelor and seemed perfectly happy living alone.
او در چهل سالگی هنوز مرد مجردی بود و به نظر می‌رسید از زندگی تنها کاملاً راضی است.
My uncle, a lifelong bachelor, spends most weekends fishing by the lake.
عمویم که تمام عمرش مجرد بوده، بیشتر آخر هفته‌ها را کنار دریاچه به ماهیگیری می‌گذراند.
The story follows a wealthy bachelor who finally decides to settle down and marry.
داستان درباره یک مرد مجرد ثروتمند است که سرانجام تصمیم می‌گیرد ازدواج کند و زندگی مستقری داشته باشد.
miniContext: A bachelor is a man who has never married, and the word is often used to describe a particular lifestyle associated with independence and living alone. Older novels and films frequently feature a bachelor who enjoys his freedom until he meets someone who changes his mind about marriage. The term specifically refers to marital status, not just being single at a given moment.

examples: To qualify for the scholarship, students must maintain a high grade point average.
برای واجد شرایط شدن دریافت بورسیه، دانش‌آموزان باید معدل بالایی داشته باشند.
She trained for months to qualify for the national swimming team.
او ماه‌ها تمرین کرد تا واجد شرایط عضویت در تیم ملی شنا شود.
His years of experience in accounting helped him qualify for the senior position.
سال‌ها تجربه او در حسابداری باعث شد واجد شرایط آن سمت ارشد شود.
miniContext: To qualify means to meet the necessary requirements or standards to be eligible for something, such as a job, a competition, or a benefit. An athlete must qualify by achieving a certain time or score, and a job applicant must qualify by having the right education or experience. The word is often followed by 'for,' as in qualify for a loan, a race, or a visa.
